title: Exact 6-cut rigidity and small-order superconnectivity for the 6-regular case of Dirac's k=4 problem
summary: Dirac asked in 1970 whether for every k >= 4 there is a k-vertex-critical graph without critical edges; Jensen settled all k >= 5, and only k=4 remains open. Following Skottova and Steiner, call a graph G a (4,1)-graph if chi(G)=4, chi(G-v)=3 for every vertex v, and chi(G-e)=4 for every edge e; they proved delta(G) >= 6 and lambda(G) >= 6 for every (4,1)-graph and asked whether a 6-regular (4,1)-graph exists.
